fnol_text: My name is Samuel Herrera and I live at 480 Willow Place, Dover, DE 19920. You can reach me on (555) 860-7310 or samuel.herrera@example.com. A stone thrown up by a lorry cracked my windscreen right across on 23 July 2024. Policy MT-2023-00011. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Herrera on (555) 860-7310 to acknowledge the claim. Samuel confirmed the loss date as 23 July 2024.
